baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relative clause attached to الجنة and the nested من عبادنا من كان تقيا make نورث a selective transfer.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is cast as an estate that God vests in a subset of His servants: servant relation defines the pool, while an established state of taqwa marks the recipient.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies a tree-covered enclosure as the concrete estate being transferred.
The branch supplies succession from a prior holder to an heir, making possession rather than mere movement the governing relation.
The causative branch supplies vesting without bargain or burden, assigning God as grantor rather than seller.
The branch supplies submissive service as the relation shared by the wider class from which heirs are selected.
The branch supplies a state holding in time, so the qualification reads as established rather than momentary.
The branch supplies deliberate self-placement within protection as the disposition selecting the heir.

changed_reading.before: A garden is simply given to pious people.
changed_reading.after: A protected estate is selectively vested in servants whose protective orientation has become an established state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الجنة and تقيا place an enclosing destination beside a recipient defined by protective practice.
baseline_models.mechanism: The destination corresponds materially to the heir's disposition: concealment and shielding on the garden side answer self-protection on the servant side, while inheritance converts practiced protection into a possessed habitat.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies concealment from perception, making the destination a veiled domain.
The branch supplies a protective shield, turning enclosure into active shelter.
The branch supplies a barrier that repels harm, linking the recipient's trait to the destination's sheltering form.
The branch supplies the agent's act of entering protection, making taqwa a practiced orientation rather than a label.
The branch supplies the vesting act that turns correspondence between practice and habitat into possession.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is an external condition for entry into paradise.
changed_reading.after: The heir's practiced self-protection matures into possession of a shielding, veiled habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence first presents a later generation standing after predecessors but deteriorating and losing prayer, then an exception marked by repair and entry into the garden. The focus therefore separates chronological succession from valid inheritance: coming later gives no title, while repaired protective service does.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the focus's heir-succession frame whose eligibility the context revises.
The branch supplies a later party taking a predecessor's place, creating a direct but insufficient succession parallel.
The branch supplies deterioration after succession, breaking any equation between lateness and worthy title.
The branch supplies loss and disappearance, functioning as forfeiture within the failed succession.
The branch supplies repair as the reversal of corruption and the reopened basis for eligibility.
The branch supplies actual entry into the enclosure, completing the repaired succession before the focus names it inheritance.

structural_cues: 19:59 sets a successor generation after predecessors; 19:60 opens an exception that culminates in entry into the same garden.
The focus's partitive من عبادنا and repeated من prevent the servant class from functioning as automatic title.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chronological replacement, deterioration, repair, and entry; I infer a title-allocation contrast between succession by time and succession by fitness. A live alternative is a conduct-result contrast without a legal succession mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Inheritance names the final transfer to a class of good servants.
changed_reading.after: Inheritance corrects a failed succession: historical successors can lose the title, while repaired servants become the true heirs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden is promised to servants while hidden, the promise is characterized as coming, and its provision is apportioned across paired daily poles. Inheritance becomes an assured but unseen bequest whose possession is experienced as repeatedly arriving supply, not a static deed handed over once.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies gratuitous vesting as the stable legal core of the arriving provision.
The branch supplies a spoken commitment that opens expectation, placing the inheritance under assurance before possession.
The branch supplies concealment from sight, making present invisibility compatible with secured title.
The branch supplies coming and arrival, converting the promise from remote statement into approaching fulfillment.
The branch supplies an apportioned gift, recasting estate possession as sustained allocation.
The branch supplies the opening pole of the day, helping mark recurrent provision.
The branch supplies the evening pole paired with morning, closing the cycle of recurrent provision.

structural_cues: 19:61 moves from promise in the unseen to a promise described as coming.
19:62 pairs morning and evening around the possessive رزقهم, giving the promised estate a recurring distributive rhythm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden promise, arrival, apportioned provision, and paired times; I infer recurrent delivery within secured inheritance. The paired times may alternatively signify uninterrupted sufficiency rather than literal periodic distribution.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a future estate received in one transfer.
changed_reading.after: The garden is an unseen but secured bequest whose grant keeps arriving as an apportioned, recurrent provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context requires purposeful action, repair, obedience to command, worship, and patient restraint, but the focus's causative inheritance branch marks vesting without bargain or cost. These practices shape and identify the fit heir; they do not function as a purchase price for the garden.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies transfer without contract or burden, blocking a simple wage-for-property equation.
The branch supplies intentional work, establishing that recipient formation includes enacted conduct.
The branch supplies repair opposed to corruption, defining the work by restored fitness rather than exchange value.
The branch supplies binding command, placing service under authority rather than commercial negotiation.
The branch supplies commanded worship and submissive service, activating the same relation named by عبادنا in the focus.
The branch supplies sustained self-restraint, making the heir's qualification durable rather than episodic.

structural_cues: 19:60 sequences turning, trust, and repaired action before entry without diminution.
19:64-65 place descent, command, worship, and endurance under one Lord's administration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncompensated vesting together with labor and service; I infer the legal distinction between qualification and consideration. A live alternative is that ordinary recompense language still makes action causally productive without implying purchase.

changed_reading.before: Pious servants earn the garden as compensation for work.
changed_reading.after: Service forms the servants into fit heirs, but the title itself remains a gratuitous divine vesting rather than a sale.

context_deltas.mechanism: Everyone is brought to a mandated point of arrival; then those who practiced taqwa are separated into safety while wrongdoers are left in place. The focus's selective inheritance is thus procedural and post-exposure: protective practice becomes the operative sorting criterion, and the garden is the allotment of those extracted from common danger.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies transfer to heirs as the possession produced after contextual sorting.
The branch supplies practiced self-protection as the focus's selection criterion.
The branch supplies common arrival at the dangerous locus, placing all parties before the later separation.
The branch supplies an unavoidable binding determination, making the exposure a mandated stage rather than an accident.
The branch supplies rescue by separation, furnishing the directional move from shared exposure toward inheritance.
The branch repeats practiced protection in the rescue clause, directly activating the focus's تقي selection.
The branch supplies leaving in place, creating the residual contrast against those separated into safety.

structural_cues: 19:68-70 gather, present, and rank the opposed parties before 19:71-72 narrate common arrival followed by rescue and leaving.
The exact focus root و ق ي recurs in 19:72 at the moment of rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies common arrival, binding decree, rescue by separation, and leaving behind; I infer a staged exposure-and-allotment mechanism. ورود may alternatively denote approach or presentation rather than traversal, so the model does not require a completed crossing.

changed_reading.before: The protected are admitted directly to their inherited garden.
changed_reading.after: The heirs receive the garden after mandated common exposure, when practiced protection becomes visible as rescue and separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later argument ranks groups by visible residence, assembly, furnishings, and appearance, then recalls the destruction of generations that excelled in those measures and names enduring good acts as the better returning recompense. Against that metric, the garden's concealment and inheritance fields combine into veiled, durable capital whose value is disclosed by survival and return rather than present display.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies concealment, making the true estate unavailable to the context's immediate visual ranking.
The branch supplies durable title across succession, opposing possessions whose holders and generations vanish.
The branch supplies residence or station as one explicit public metric being contested.
The branch supplies the social assembly, locating the rival claim in visible collective prestige.
The branch supplies abundant goods and furnishings as material evidence that proves unable to endure.
The branch supplies visible appearance, sharpening the contrast between what can be inspected now and the veiled estate.
The branch supplies destruction, cancelling visible abundance as proof of lasting title.
The branch supplies persistence, identifying durability as the alternative measure of value.
The branch supplies recompense returning to its doer, giving the hidden inheritance a return structure rather than a display structure.

structural_cues: 19:73 poses a comparative claim about better station and assembly; 19:74 answers with destroyed generations that had better goods and appearance.
19:76 closes the comparison with what endures, better returned recompense, and a better final return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies display metrics, destroyed possessors, enduring acts, and returning recompense; I infer an estate-value contrast in which hidden durability defeats visible capital. The sequence can alternatively be read as a general prestige-reward contrast without activating the garden's concealment branch.

changed_reading.before: The garden is the more splendid place possessed by the righteous.
changed_reading.after: The inherited garden is veiled, durable capital whose worth appears in what survives and returns, not in present furnishings or social display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hoof-protection branch of و ق ي rather than the ordinary ethical branch. It remains valid as a material analogy anchored in تقي and sharpened by mandated arrival plus guidance; downstream prose should label it an exploratory image of careful passage, never a lexical translation of تقي.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective تقيا can carry, at branch distance, an image of guarding one's footing from injurious ground.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies an animal protecting its hoof and hesitating on rough ground, materializing taqwa as guarded footing.
The branch supplies arrival at the dangerous locus, giving the guarded-footing image terrain through which it matters.
The branch supplies unavoidable determination, preventing the image from becoming simple avoidance of the route.
The branch supplies gentle direction along a path, converting guarded footing into guided passage rather than paralysis.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is only a settled moral quality that qualifies an heir.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, taqwa is guarded footing: a guided way of preserving oneself through an unavoidable approach before receiving shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ember-stirring branch of و ر ث is not the syntactically selected inheritance sense. It remains packet-anchored in the exact focus root and is activated by nearby fire exposure followed by rescue; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary lexical afterimage, never as the translation of نورث.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نورث carries a remote branch in which the same root stirs embers until fire catches.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies deliberate stirring of embers into flame, giving the transfer verb a latent ignition image.
The branch supplies encounter with fire and heat, contextually activating the otherwise remote ignition image.
The branch supplies escape by separation, directing the ignition resonance toward renewed possession after exposure rather than toward destruction.

changed_reading.before: God transfers an already complete garden estate to its heirs.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical afterimage, the transfer also feels deliberately kindled on the far side of fire exposure and rescue.

strongest_changes: The failed خلف sequence separates chronological succession from worthy inheritance.
The recurrence of و ق ي at rescue turns taqwa from a static label into the operative criterion after common exposure.
Visible station, assembly, furnishings, and appearance yield to a veiled estate measured by durability and return.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's inheritance, enclosure, and protection branches lock into the context's failed succession, unseen delivery, commanded service, universal exposure, and durable return. The result supports legal, spatial, and material readings without collapsing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: ورود in 19:71 may indicate arrival, approach, or traversal; the rescue model does not settle that choice.
The morning-evening pair may mark literal recurrence or idiomatic uninterrupted provision.
The guarded-footing and ember-stirring readings are branch-backed analogies, not lexical substitutions.
